entries.note: Seen live as the first scan of a station-to-station shipment, at the origin station and without a clock zone.
Seen live as the first scan of a shipment Forward Air collects from the shipper. A driver is sent to the shipper.
Seen live. The driver reached the shipper; the freight is not collected yet.
Seen live. The driver collected the freight from the shipper.
Seen live. The freight was handed in at the origin station.
Seen live at the origin station after the pickup or the receipt there and before the departure.
Seen live at the origin station and at stations on the way.
Seen live at a station on the way.
Seen live. The freight reached the destination station, where the consignee collects it or a driver takes it on.
Seen live minutes before the delivery. The driver reached the consignee.
Seen live; the shipment's proof-of-delivery time is the scan's.

Seen live as the last movement of a station-to-station shipment; the shipment's proof-of-delivery time is the scan's. The consignee collected the freight at the destination station, which ends Forward Air's service.
Seen live as a shipment's current status. The shipment was cancelled.
Seen live as the last scan of finished shipments, at the head office. Billing after the movement ended; not a movement.
Listed in Forward Air's Fast Track help page among an airbill's possible statuses; not seen in a reply in this form. Received at a Forward Air station.
Listed in Forward Air's Fast Track help page among an airbill's possible statuses; not seen in a reply in this form.
Listed in Forward Air's Fast Track help page among an airbill's possible statuses; not seen in a reply in this form. Arrived at the destination station.

Listed in Forward Air's Fast Track help page among an airbill's possible statuses. The freight was taken from the destination station; replies give it the code COMP and date the proof of delivery with it.
